sip_server.name: SIP Server Host
sip_server.description: 1. In UniFi Talk, open Talk > Phones > Add Third-Party Device > Overview. Copy SIP Server Host exactly as shown. Do not use a SIP Trunk Provider value.

sip_port.name: SIP Server Port
sip_port.description: 2. In the same Talk > Phones > Add Third-Party Device > Overview screen, copy SIP Server Port exactly as shown.

sip_extension.name: SIP Username
sip_extension.description: 3. In the same Talk > Phones > Add Third-Party Device > Overview screen, copy SIP Username exactly as shown. This is not the SIP Trunk Provider field Auth Username.

sip_password.name: SIP Password
sip_password.description: 4. In the same Talk > Phones > Add Third-Party Device > Overview screen, copy SIP Password exactly as shown. This is not the SIP Trunk Provider Password.

sip_transport.name: SIP Transport
sip_transport.description: Transport for the dedicated Third-Party Device registration. Keep udp unless separate, verified device instructions require tcp or tls. Do not derive this from a SIP Trunk Provider configuration.

outbound_proxy.name: Outbound Proxy
outbound_proxy.description: Optional full sip: or sips: proxy URI for the dedicated Third-Party Device. Normally leave this empty. Never copy the SIP Trunk Provider fields SIP Proxy or Realm here.

api_token.name: API Token (create it yourself)
api_token.description: Create this private token yourself and share it only with the Home Assistant integration. It does not come from UniFi Talk. Use 32-512 non-whitespace characters; a 64-character random hex token is recommended.

api_port.name: Local API Port
api_port.description: Loopback-only port used by the Home Assistant integration to reach this add-on. Keep 8099 unless that port is already in use.

allowed_number_rules.name: Allowed Number Rules
allowed_number_rules.description: Destinations that the add-on may call. Use exact:150 for one number, prefix:+49 for a prefix, or * only when every otherwise safe destination must be allowed.

blocked_number_rules.name: Blocked Number Rules
blocked_number_rules.description: Additional destinations that must never be called. Use exact: or prefix: rules. A block rule always overrides an allow rule; built-in emergency blocks remain active.

allowed_audio_hosts.name: Allowed Audio Hosts
allowed_audio_hosts.description: Exact hostnames or IP addresses from which audio_url WAV files may be downloaded. Enter no scheme, port, path, wildcard, or credentials.

tts_voice.name: TTS Voice
tts_voice.description: eSpeak voice used for locally generated call messages, for example de or en.

tts_speed.name: TTS Speed
tts_speed.description: Speaking speed for locally generated messages in words per minute.

max_calls_per_window.name: Maximum Calls per Window
max_calls_per_window.description: Maximum number of successfully prepared outbound calls allowed during one rate-limit window.

rate_limit_window_seconds.name: Rate-Limit Window (seconds)
rate_limit_window_seconds.description: Length of the sliding outbound-call rate-limit window in seconds.

max_audio_bytes.name: Maximum Audio Size (bytes)
max_audio_bytes.description: Largest remote WAV download accepted before a call is rejected.

max_audio_seconds.name: Maximum Audio Duration (seconds)
max_audio_seconds.description: Longest WAV or generated message duration accepted for one call.

hangup_buffer_seconds.name: Hangup Buffer (seconds)
hangup_buffer_seconds.description: Extra fallback time added after the calculated audio duration before the add-on hangs up.

terminal_state_seconds.name: Terminal State Duration (seconds)
terminal_state_seconds.description: How long the final call result remains visible before the state returns to idle.

log_level.name: Log Level
log_level.description: Minimum detail written to the add-on log. Use debug only temporarily and review logs before sharing them.
